svg.title: LOMN Web progress on 2026-11-13: the script engine runs the game's menu script; the menu itself renders next
svg.text: 2026-11-13. Every number below comes from a test run on that day's code (m2-osi-vm @ 80bc109).
Stages 1-2 of 5 done: the original's menu logic read
from its code, test formats fixed. Now: camera,
mouse, INI and fonts, each built twice (C++, Python).
The real main menu, drawn by this project,
compared with screenshots of the original game.
Until then the script engine runs headless.

g.text: Script VM: 541 of 541 test programs give byte-identical traces in C++ and in an independent Python version.
The game's Base.osi runs setup + 600 frames: native, WebAssembly and Python agree on all 601 frame digests.
69 engine functions the script calls: 35 rebuilt from the original's code, 34 proven not to change the run.
Planted bugs caught by the tests: 46 of 46 in the VM, 6 of 6 in the engine functions.
Browser viewer: 60 of 60 checks on the real game files, pixel-identical to the desktop build.

svg.text: M2 (script engine to the main menu)
3 of 6 steps done: citations, VM + oracle, engine functions. Next: menu, hardening, menu in the browser.
